Only 22% of remote job listings show a pay figure. The rest are marked "DOE"—determined on experience—leaving you to guess the USD salary that matches your expertise.

According to Loker Dollar's data, out of 4,280 active remote listings, 940 (22%) disclose a salary, while 3,340 (78%) don't. But DOE isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever. For example, Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments, and 64% of listings (2,735) accept applicants from any country.

1,213 listings were posted in the last 7 days. Understanding DOE is key to negotiating effectively.

Read the full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/what-is-doe-wage
